name: Session presets
description: ADE sessions that open with a set of panes: two agents side by side, a review pair, or an agent with a shell.

sessionPresets.name: Claude and a shell
sessionPresets.description: Claude Code beside a shell for running things yourself.

sessionPresets.name: Claude and Codex
sessionPresets.description: Two agents side by side on the same branch.

sessionPresets.name: Orient, then build
sessionPresets.description: One agent maps the project first; a second waits for your task.

panes.name: Guide
panes.prompt: Read this project and tell me in under 30 lines what it is, how it's laid out, and how to run and test it. Don't change any files.

sessionPresets.name: Review pair
sessionPresets.description: Claude and Codex each review the branch's changes; neither edits files.

panes.name: Reviewer
panes.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes and this branch's commits that aren't on the main branch. List bugs and risky spots by file and line, most serious first. Don't edit any files.

panes.name: Second opinion
panes.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes and this branch's commits that aren't on the main branch. List bugs and risky spots by file and line, most serious first. Don't edit any files.
